│   │   └── PACKAGE_CONTENTS.txt      ← What's included
│   │

│   │   ├── README.md                 ← Tech index
│   │   ├── ARCHITECTURE.md           ← System design
│   │   ├── FEATURES.md               ← Feature list

│   │

│       ├── README.md                 ← Dev index

│       ├── SETUP.md                  ← Dev setup

│       ├── WHATS_NEW.md              ← Changelog
│       ├── SUMMARY.md                ← Summary
│       ├── FINAL_SUMMARY.md          ← Final status

│   ├── main.py                       ← FastAPI server
│   ├── model_manager.py              ← AI model handler
│   ├── config.py                     ← Configuration
│   ├── requirements.txt              ← Dependencies
│   ├── requirements-simple.txt       ← Simple deps
│   ├── venv/                         ← Virtual environment

│
├── 🎨 frontend/ (User Interface)
│   ├── src/
│   │   ├── App.js                    ← Main React app
│   │   ├── App.css                   ← Styles
│   │   └── index.js                  ← Entry point
│   ├── public/
│   │   └── index.html                ← HTML template
│   ├── build/                        ← Production build
│   ├── node_modules/                 ← npm packages
│   └── package.json                  ← npm config
│
└── 🔨 build/ (Build Tools - Optional)
    ├── build_exe.py                  ← Build script
    ├── launcher.py                   ← Exe launcher
    ├── BUILD.bat                     ← Build batch
    └── CREATE_SHORTCUT.bat           ← Old shortcut

🎯 QUICK NAVIGATION

For Users:
  → Start: AudioCraft-Lite.bat
  → Help: docs/user-guides/START_HERE_SIMPLE.md
  → Files: OPEN_MY_AUDIO_FILES.bat

For Developers:
  → Build: docs/developer/BUILD_INSTRUCTIONS.md
  → Guide: docs/developer/COMPLETE_GUIDE.md
  → Setup: docs/developer/SETUP.md

For Technical Info:
  → Architecture: docs/technical/ARCHITECTURE.md
  → Features: docs/technical/FEATURES.md
